layer: declared breaks in each outcome series — description, never attribution

rules.method: Bai–Perron break search (strucchange::breakpoints) on a mean-only model of the native observations, with the number of breaks chosen by BIC against the no-break model
rules.criterion: BIC, compared with the no-break model; the smallest BIC wins, and no break wins ties
rules.input_rule: native observations only (`fact_observation_native`, anchored at anchor_month); the interpolated monthly spine is never fitted, because a filled month is a rule and not a record
rules.definition_break_rule: a declared definition break inside the span is always published as `known_definition_break`; an estimated break within ±1 native period of one is relabelled as measurement and the two are not listed twice
rules.attribution_rule: no break is described as an effect of a president, party or tenure; `coincides_with_inauguration` records timing only and is null unless the break falls within ±2 months of a swearing-in
